ERIS: New Diabetes Treatment Launch Will Drive Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Eris Lifesciences from ₹1,712.60 to ₹1,696.60 as they now apply a slightly higher discount rate, factor in more moderate revenue growth and profit margins, and assume a higher future P/E multiple. What's in the News Eris Lifesciences announced the launch of its generic semaglutide under the brand SUNDAE in India, offering multi dose vial formats at prices starting at ₹1,290 per month for 2 mg/1.5 ml and 4 mg/3 ml variants, with plans to introduce a pen device version in April priced at ₹4,000, ₹4,200 and ₹4,500 per month for the 2 mg/1.5 ml, 4 mg/3 ml and 8 mg/3 ml strengths respectively.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹45.33 (up from ₹25.85 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹31.4b (up 9.0% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹6.20b (up 76% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 20% (up from 12% in FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.8%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 22%. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 9% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 31% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Eris Lifesciences Limited (NSEI:ERIS) completed the acquisition of Probiotics business of Velbiom Probiotics Private Limited.
news.body:
Eris Lifesciences Limited (NSEI:ERIS) agreed to acquire Probiotics business of Velbiom Probiotics Private Limited for INR 500 million on March 20, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 500 million will be paid by Eris Lifesciences Limited. As part of consideration, INR 500 million is paid towards assets of Probiotics business of Velbiom Probiotics Private Limited. 
Eris Lifesciences Limited (NSEI:ERIS) completed the acquisition of Probiotics business of Velbiom Probiotics Private Limited on March 31, 2026.

news.title: ERIS: Diabetes Franchise Expansion And Probiotic Acquisition Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Eris Lifesciences stable at ₹1,743.60, citing only marginal updates to revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions in their models. What's in the News The board will meet on Mar 20, 2026 to consider a Business Transfer Agreement with Velbiom Probiotics for acquiring its branded probiotic products on a slump sale basis, along with related documents and terms in the BTA (company filing).

What's in the News Eris Lifesciences announced a partnership with Natco Pharma to commercialise Semaglutide in India, focusing on Type 2 diabetes and chronic weight management.

news.title: ERIS: Diabetes Partnership Will Drive Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have modestly trimmed their price target on Eris Lifesciences from ₹1,778.20 to ₹1,743.60, citing recalibrated expectations for revenue growth and future P/E, along with slightly higher projected profit margins. What's in the News Eris Lifesciences entered a partnership with Natco Pharma for the commercialisation of semaglutide in India, focusing on Type 2 diabetes and chronic weight management therapies (Client Announcements).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹7.32 (up from ₹6.15 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹8.01b (up 11% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹997.2m (up 19% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 13% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 20%. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 1% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 30% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

This has led to a small, model driven adjustment in the implied price target rather than a major change in conviction.
